issues.title: Export the SDK as ESM Only
Chain Configs for the fuels CLI should be extendable off of the default one
SDK fails when Contract returns `String` in a `Struct` or `Tuple`

discussions.title: Proposal to change typegen'd predicate initialisation arguments
Re-instantiate Typedocs for `hidden` exported functions in `Account`
Is the  "param1" of the call receipt no longer the function selector on the testnet?
